History:
74-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2022, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: hypertension, type 2 diabetes.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 15 mg weekly for 31 weeks despite good adherence.
